note: Imported in Overhaul slice 1 (data only). No game system reads this file yet.

entries.name: Kanto Trio
entries.scene: The three old partners line up in the clearing, trying not to look as if they planned it.
entries.reward: Unlocks the "Where It Began" scene at the next rest node

entries.name: Johto Trio
entries.scene: The three of them sit in a row and share a berry three ways.

entries.name: Hoenn Trio
entries.scene: The trio spreads out to cover three sides of the campfire without being asked.

entries.name: Sinnoh Trio
entries.scene: One chases the other two around the camp until all three collapse in a laughing heap.

entries.name: Unova Trio
entries.scene: They stand shoulder to shoulder and stare down the horizon together.

entries.name: Kalos Trio
entries.scene: Each insists it should lead; they settle it with a very serious rock-paper-scissors.

entries.name: Alola Trio
entries.scene: They arrange themselves on a log and watch the sunset in silence.

entries.name: Galar Trio
entries.scene: They cheer each other on, even when one is clearly losing the race.
entries.reward: Unlocks the "Race to the Rest" scene

entries.name: Paldea Trio
entries.scene: They each bring a gift and wait to see who's picked.

entries.name: Starter Hearts
entries.scene: Two starters from different regions compare their old trainers' habits.

entries.name: Positive and Negative
entries.scene: The two of them spark in rhythm and look delighted about it.
entries.reward: Unlocks a rhythm cheer after wins

entries.name: Eon Siblings
entries.scene: They fly in a perfect circle around the party, then settle down as though nothing happened.

entries.name: Firefly Dance
entries.scene: They draw patterns in the night sky together.
entries.reward: Night camp scenes show their light show

entries.name: Nidoran Pair
entries.scene: Each lifts its ears at the other, then pretends not to notice.

entries.name: Sword and Shield
entries.scene: They stand back to back, ready for anything.

entries.name: Sun and Moon
entries.scene: One lights the day, one keeps the night, and neither says a word about it.

entries.name: Truth and Ideals
entries.scene: They stare each other down until something shifts between them.

entries.name: Sea and Land
entries.scene: The sky turns the colors of both sea and land, then calms.

entries.name: Time and Space
entries.scene: The air bends in two directions at once and then steadies.

entries.name: Life and Destruction
entries.scene: They circle each other, each stopping the other from going too far.

entries.name: Dream and Nightmare
entries.scene: One chases the other's shadow, and the nightmares fade.

entries.name: Origin and Echo
entries.scene: The little one floats around the big one, who watches with surprising patience.

entries.name: Guardian Deities
entries.scene: All four settle onto the island stones and watch you in silence.

entries.name: Swords of Justice
entries.scene: They form a line and wait for the trainer's word.

entries.name: Forces of Nature
entries.scene: Wind, thunder and earth take positions around the camp, arguing quietly.

entries.name: Legendary Birds
entries.scene: The three perch on the cliff and look across the world.

entries.name: Roaming Beasts
entries.scene: They race the wind and pause only for you.

entries.name: The Regis
entries.scene: The three stand like statues, then slowly turn their heads toward you.

entries.name: Lake Guardians
entries.scene: They hover in a triangle, thinking three different thoughts at the same time.

entries.name: Creation Trio
entries.scene: Three pillars of the world gather and look wary of each other.

entries.name: Weather Trio
entries.scene: Three forces of weather stand in silence as storms gather and then break.

entries.name: Tao Trio
entries.scene: Three dragons gather where truth, ideals and emptiness meet.

entries.name: Aura Trio
entries.scene: Life, destruction and order stand in a triangle.

entries.name: Treasures of Ruin
entries.scene: Four ancient sealed things gather, whispering.

entries.name: Loyal Three
entries.scene: The three stand shoulder to shoulder, and none speaks of what happened.

entries.name: Ultra Gathering
entries.scene: Three visitors from another world compare notes in a language no one else speaks.

entries.name: Legends Together
entries.scene: Two very large presences share a very small clearing.

entries.name: Quiet Legends
entries.scene: Two lesser legends look relieved to meet someone who understands.

entries.name: Eevee Siblings
entries.scene: Three Eeveelutions bicker about whose fur is softest.

entries.name: Eevee Reunion
entries.scene: Five of Eevee's forms cluster around the fire, each in its own color.

entries.name: Eight Paths
entries.scene: Eight forms of one small creature, all in one place.

entries.name: Sun and Moon Eevees
entries.scene: The sun one and the moon one lie back to back.

entries.name: Elemental Brothers
entries.scene: Three brothers with three elements, one very full bowl.

entries.name: Season-Shifters
entries.scene: One brings spring, one winter; they stand where the two seasons meet.

entries.name: Ribbons and Fur
entries.scene: The young one tries to copy the older one's ribbons.

entries.name: Rain Squad
entries.scene: A downpour makes everyone's day, and some mons' week.

entries.name: Sun Squad
entries.scene: Two sun-lovers bask side by side and ignore the heat.

entries.name: Sand Squad
entries.scene: Two sand-lovers shake out their coats together.

entries.name: Snow Squad
entries.scene: Two cold-lovers build a pile of snow and sit on it.

entries.name: Rain Team Core
entries.scene: One pulls the clouds in; the other swims through them.

entries.name: Sun Core
entries.scene: The sun beats down, and the leaves drink it in.

entries.name: Sand Core
entries.scene: A roar and a whir in the same sandstorm.

entries.name: Snow Core
entries.scene: One of them looms, the other slips through the drifts.

entries.name: Slow Pair
entries.scene: Two slow Pokémon share the slowest, quietest afternoon.

entries.name: Flame Trio
entries.scene: Three fire-types warm up the camp until everyone has to step back.

entries.name: Tide Trio
entries.scene: Three water-types splash around the nearest puddle until it's a pond.

entries.name: Grove Trio
entries.scene: Three grass-types sun themselves in a row, photosynthesizing seriously.

entries.name: Spark Trio
entries.scene: Three electric-types make everyone's fur stand on end.

entries.name: Mind Trio
entries.scene: Three psychics sit in a triangle, nodding at what no one else hears.

entries.name: Haunt Trio
entries.scene: The campfire dims; three ghosts exchange knowing looks.

entries.name: Dragon Trio
entries.scene: The three of them argue about wings versus scales with equal passion.

entries.name: Dojo Trio
entries.scene: Three fighters spar at dawn without being asked.

entries.name: Shadow Trio
entries.scene: Three dark-types find the one shadow big enough for all.

entries.name: Forge Trio
entries.scene: Three steel-types gleam in the firelight and tap each other's plating.

entries.name: Glimmer Trio
entries.scene: Three fairies braid flowers in each other's fur.

entries.name: Frost Trio
entries.scene: Three ice-types frost the camp's rocks and giggle.

entries.name: Boulder Trio
entries.scene: Three rock-types stand so still that a bird lands on one.

entries.name: Dust Trio
entries.scene: Three ground-types dig the same hole from three sides.

entries.name: Venom Trio
entries.scene: Three poison-types share a quiet, cautious meal.

entries.name: Swarm Trio
entries.scene: Three bug-types hum in the same key.

entries.name: Gale Trio
entries.scene: Three flyers circle overhead and trade the lead.

entries.name: Everyday Trio
entries.scene: Three plain Pokémon do very ordinary, very pleasant things.

entries.name: Six Colors
entries.scene: Six different elements and not a single clash.

entries.name: Pallet Reunion
entries.scene: The whole team feels like they're back where the story began.

entries.name: Johto Reunion
entries.scene: The team hums a half-remembered tune from somewhere in Johto.

entries.name: Hoenn Reunion
entries.scene: The air smells faintly of salt and ash.

entries.name: Sinnoh Reunion
entries.scene: Everyone looks toward the mountain, as if remembering it.

entries.name: Unova Reunion
entries.scene: A city's hum drifts in from somewhere that isn't here.

entries.name: Kalos Reunion
entries.scene: Everyone straightens up a little, as if in a fine hall.

entries.name: Alola Reunion
entries.scene: The team sways slightly, as if to waves.

entries.name: Galar Reunion
entries.scene: The team stands in formation, as if before a stadium.

entries.name: Paldea Reunion
entries.scene: Everyone sniffs the air toward a horizon that isn't there.

entries.name: Fully Grown
entries.scene: Every member of the team has grown as far as it can.

entries.name: Still Growing
entries.scene: The whole team looks up at you with the same unfinished, hopeful face.

entries.name: Floaters
entries.scene: Two floaters drift over the camp, looking down on everyone gently.

entries.name: Glare Squad
entries.scene: Two glaring mons stare each other out until they both blink.

entries.name: Pressure Pair
entries.scene: The air feels heavy around the pair.

entries.name: Sturdy Squad
entries.scene: Neither budges, even when the other pokes it.

entries.name: Big and Tiny
entries.scene: The biggest and smallest on the team sleep in a pile.
entries.reward: Unlocks the "Big and Small" camp scene

entries.name: Spark Family
entries.scene: Three generations of sparks cling together for warmth.

entries.name: Two Favorites
entries.scene: Two small, popular companions share the same sunbeam.

entries.name: Cat's Pride
entries.scene: The pampered one doesn't acknowledge the scrappy one, but saves it the best spot.

entries.name: Dragon's Education
entries.scene: The big one shows the small one how to dig; the small one bites it anyway.

entries.name: Splash and Roar
entries.scene: One splashes helplessly while the other looks fondly down.

entries.name: Slow Brothers
entries.scene: One is slow and one is clamped to its tail, and both are happy.

entries.name: Bone Keepers
entries.scene: One wears a skull and the other leaves it a quiet space.

entries.name: Lullaby Trio
entries.scene: Two sing lullabies and one tries to find the door.

entries.name: Coconut Cousins
entries.scene: The egg-heads and the tall one grow in two directions.

entries.name: Fighting Brothers
entries.scene: They argue about whose style is better, loudly.

entries.name: Gallop Pair
entries.scene: One tries to keep up while the other slows down for it.

entries.name: Rock Family
entries.scene: Two stony friends share a sunny rock.

entries.name: Mime Troupe
entries.scene: They perform an invisible play and bow.

entries.name: Feeling Family
entries.scene: A feeling team, with more being felt than said.

entries.name: Steel Family
entries.scene: The three-eyed one watches the smaller.

entries.name: Dream of Flight
entries.scene: The small one stares at the big one and dreams.

entries.name: Mountain Born
entries.scene: A growing one climbs onto the big one's shoulder.

entries.name: Old Friends
entries.scene: Two fossil revivals share the oldest memory.

entries.name: Ancient Trio
entries.scene: Three revived Pokémon look at the modern world with curiosity.

entries.name: Haunted House
entries.scene: The three move around each other in an old, familiar joke.

entries.name: Prank Duo
entries.scene: Two masters of illusion try to out-trick one another.

entries.name: Shadow and Ghost
entries.scene: They share shadows and trade secrets.

entries.name: Trick Squad
entries.scene: The team's face becomes a mask no one can read.

entries.name: Hound and Hound
entries.scene: Two big fiery dogs circle each other, then sit.

entries.name: Sky Family
entries.scene: The big one keeps watch while the small one practices.

entries.name: Quick Cousins
entries.scene: The tiny scamperer and the larger one race.

entries.name: Cocoon Reunion
entries.scene: The one who flew shows the one who crawls the view.

entries.name: Stinger Family
entries.scene: The small one doesn't realize what it will become.

entries.name: Weed Family
entries.scene: A small one hides under the big one's petals.

entries.name: Vine Family
entries.scene: The big one swallows nothing; it's just a hug.

entries.name: Muscle Family
entries.scene: The big one lifts the small one for fun.

entries.name: Dream Family
entries.scene: One sleeps and the other levitates the blanket.

entries.name: Sunrise Gallop
entries.scene: The two share a sunrise at the field's edge.

entries.name: Heavy Sleepers
entries.scene: They sleep in a pile and snore in harmony.

entries.name: Lucky Egg
entries.scene: The small one is carried everywhere; the big one is serene.

entries.name: Dragon's Wish
entries.scene: The big one protects the small one from everything.

entries.name: Wool Family
entries.scene: The small one's wool grows and the big one's light shines.

entries.name: Cloud Friends
entries.scene: The small one sits on the big one's cloud-wing.

entries.name: Desert Dragons
entries.scene: The grown one shows the small one how to fly out of the pit.

entries.name: Ugly to Beautiful
entries.scene: The grown one sings for the one still waiting.

entries.name: Lookout Pair
entries.scene: The two keep a long, tall watch.

entries.name: Swirl Family
entries.scene: The small one tries to copy the champion's pose.

entries.name: Tyrogue Dojo
entries.scene: One became three things, and they all want to be the best.

entries.name: Star-Dust Cousins
entries.scene: The big one tells the small one stories about the stars.

entries.name: Kiss Cousins
entries.scene: The big one blows kisses to the little one.

entries.name: Spark and Flame
entries.scene: Two baby elementals try to out-warm each other.

entries.name: Fire and Ice
entries.scene: One warms the camp while the other chills the drinks.

entries.name: Thunder and Rain
entries.scene: The thunder-voiced one and the rain-voiced one harmonize.

entries.name: Light and Dark
entries.scene: One shines and one hides, and they get along perfectly.

entries.name: Armor and Ribbon
entries.scene: The shiny one and the pretty one admire each other.

entries.name: Frost Wing
entries.scene: Two cold-eyed creatures breathe in sync.

entries.name: Ground and Sky
entries.scene: One looks up while the other looks down, and neither is wrong.

entries.name: Garden Pair
entries.scene: The bug rests on the grass; the grass tickles back.

entries.name: River Stones
entries.scene: The rock holds the water; the water polishes the rock.

entries.name: Sweet and Sour
entries.scene: A bright smile hides a sharper thought.

entries.name: Past and Future Wrecker
entries.scene: The big one looks at its ancient relative and tilts its head.

entries.name: Past Voice
entries.scene: One sings quietly and the other roars the same tune.

entries.name: Ancient Flight
entries.scene: One is a dream of flight and the other a memory.

entries.name: Ancient Wake
entries.scene: The old guardian and the old echo walk along the same stream.

entries.name: Ancient Flame
entries.scene: The old furnace and the old flame stand in the same heat.

entries.name: Ancient Bolt
entries.scene: Two storms from different times look at each other and bark.

entries.name: Future Knight
entries.scene: The future one doesn't know what to make of the old gentle one.

entries.name: Future Titan
entries.scene: Two great bodies meet, each unsure which is the original.

entries.name: Future Slapper
entries.scene: The tireless one claps; the iron one claps back.

entries.name: Future Hydra
entries.scene: Heads and heads and heads stare at each other.

entries.name: Future Moth
entries.scene: Two moths of fire and metal share the same flame.

entries.name: Future Winter Gift
entries.scene: Two gift-bearers meet and neither has anything to give.

entries.name: Ancient Moth
entries.scene: The old and the burning compare their wings.

entries.name: Ancient Ghost
entries.scene: A ghost and its old echo drift closer.

entries.name: Ancient Bloom
entries.scene: Two mushrooms stand at slightly different heights.

entries.name: Ancient Magnet
entries.scene: The magnets pull gently at each other.

entries.name: Future Verdant
entries.scene: Two green swordsmen trade nods.

entries.name: Future Horn
entries.scene: Two strong horns look at each other and nod.

entries.name: Future Blade
entries.scene: Two blue blades salute each other.

entries.name: Blast-Off Trio
entries.scene: The trio of schemers mutters about a plan, and the plan sounds familiar.

entries.name: Flock Together
entries.scene: A mixed flock wheels overhead and lands in formation.

entries.name: Classic Triangle
entries.scene: The old triangle, in the same camp, looking at one another with respect.

entries.name: Trade Family
entries.scene: Two Pokémon who changed through an exchange share a look of understanding.

entries.name: Stone Family
entries.scene: Two stone-evolved Pokémon polish each other's gems.

entries.name: Friendship Family
entries.scene: Two friendship-evolved Pokémon lean on each other.

entries.name: Twin Sparkles
entries.scene: Two shiny Pokémon catch the same light and glow double.

entries.name: Radiant Legend
entries.scene: A legend and a sparkle stand in the same light.

entries.name: Hatchling and Titan
entries.scene: The smallest bows to the biggest, who bows back.

entries.name: Mythical Pair
entries.scene: Two mythical Pokémon look at each other as if sharing a very old secret.

entries.name: Time-Lost Pair
entries.scene: Two time-lost visitors look around the camp, bewildered and calm.

entries.name: Time Capsule
entries.scene: Six generations in one team: someone starts a story, and everyone adds a verse.

entries.name: Food Chain
entries.scene: Everyone is very carefully not looking at everyone else.

entries.name: Cave Dwellers
entries.scene: The camp goes dark and quiet in an oddly cozy way.

entries.name: Sea Folk
entries.scene: A salt-smell settles around the pair, and they sigh in unison.

entries.name: Field Folk
entries.scene: Three field-dwellers roll in the same patch of grass.

entries.name: Shapeless Crew
entries.scene: Two shapeless things share a puddle of nothing in particular.

entries.name: Mineral Crew
entries.scene: Two mineral beings hum at a frequency only they hear.

entries.name: Fairy Ring
entries.scene: A ring of tiny fairies forms and holds a very serious meeting.

entries.name: Humanoid Crew
entries.scene: Three humanoids nod to each other like old colleagues.

entries.name: Dragon Kin
entries.scene: Two dragon-kin compare scales.

entries.name: Unknown Pair
entries.scene: Two unknowns compare how much they know about themselves, and agree it's not much.
